note: The 10-12 published facts the top findings/credits rest on. Each is the value the scorer USED; if wrong on-chain, the grade moves materially. Validator: use eth_call at a block near the run window (2026-07-29 ~21:44 UTC) plus one pinned historical read; getCode() to confirm EOA vs contract.

facts.load_bearing_for: TOP finding (-17.85 raw, the single largest deduction; sets grade ceiling near B->C)
facts.why: This is the single-key freeze headline. If threshold is actually >=3, weakness drops from 0.85 to ~0.2 and this finding falls from -17.85 to ~-4; grade rises toward B.
facts.onchain_check: GnosisSafe.getThreshold() and getOwners().length at a recent block

facts.load_bearing_for: TOP finding value band (1.0) + credits M9/M10
facts.why: Drives the >$1B band on the freeze finding AND on the timelock-upgrade credit. If WeETH value were <$100M the top finding's band falls 1.0->0.7 and grade rises.
facts.onchain_check: weETH.totalSupply() * weETH/USD (or getRate() * underlying eETH price). weETH is a wrapper; value ~= wrapped eETH TVL.

facts.field: who is authorized to call pauseUntil
facts.scorer_used: callable by Safe 0x427989 (1/5) AND Safe 0x2aca (4/7); weakest path = the 1/5
facts.why: If 0x427989 is NOT actually authorized for pauseUntil (e.g. only 0x2aca is), the top finding disappears entirely.
facts.onchain_check: Read WeETH's roles/authority (Solmate RolesAuthority canCall, or the PAUSER role holder) for the pauseUntil selector; confirm 0x427989 is permitted.

facts.field: account type (EOA vs contract) + pause authority
facts.scorer_used: EOA (weakness 0.9), holds pause.set on 6 contracts totaling ~$545M direct (EtherFiRestaker, LiquidityPool, ...)
facts.why: If this address is actually a multisig/timelock contract, weakness drops and the finding shrinks 2-4x. If it is a hot EOA, a single key can freeze $545M.
facts.onchain_check: eth_getCode(0x9af1298...) == '0x' (EOA); then confirm it holds the pauser role on EtherFiRestaker/LiquidityPool.

facts.scorer_used: callable by EOA 0x67e10b7764a99165665557b3e6cf24555bfc88c3 AND Safe 0x2aca (4/7); weakest = EOA (0.9)
facts.why: The doc's canonical headline. If the EOA is not authorized (only the Safe is), the finding drops from -12.15 to a strong-safe finding ~-2.7.
facts.onchain_check: eth_getCode(0x67e10b77...) == '0x'; then EtherFiRestaker role/authority check that 0x67e10b77 may call withdrawEther.

facts.scorer_used: destination NOT proven caller-arbitrary (claim tier idiom_structural, no arbitrary-destination witness) => operational routing power, severity 0.25, NOT extraction 0.9
facts.why: If the destination is in fact attacker-controllable, severity is 3.6x higher and these become ~-40 raw catastrophic findings. The scorer deliberately refuses to assume extraction without a witness (inv.2).
facts.onchain_check: Read EtherFiRestaker source (Etherscan/artifact): confirm _withdrawEther sends to a hardcoded liquidityPool, not a caller parameter. (This is the fact that keeps the finding operational.)

facts.why: The one proven caller-arbitrary flow.out on a non-contract gate. Small value keeps it mid-tier; if value were higher it would rival the freeze finding.
facts.onchain_check: eth_getCode(0xd8f3803...) == '0x'; confirm sweepETH takes a destination param and is onlyOwner==that EOA.

facts.load_bearing_for: CREDIT: strong change management keeps upgrade risk ~0
facts.scorer_used: gated by timelock 0x9f26d4c958fd811a1f59b01b86be7dffc9d20761 (weakness 0.15). 44 upgrade functions across 22 contracts are timelock-gated.
facts.why: This is the biggest credit: if WeETH upgrade were EOA-gated it would be a ~-54 raw catastrophic finding (grade F). The timelock is why etherfi is C not F.
facts.onchain_check: WeETH proxy admin / _getAdmin() or upgrade role == 0x9f26d4...; confirm the timelock is the proxy admin.

facts.load_bearing_for: CREDIT magnitude: the timelock's protective strength
facts.why: A 10-day delay gives detection/response time; if the delay were ~0 the timelock credit collapses and upgrade findings re-inflate.

facts.load_bearing_for: 88 warnings (68 of them) => confidence 53.4%, NOT extra deductions
facts.scorer_used: gated by a `contract` principal (Boring merkle-manager) whose own authority is not reduced to a key => weakest path UNKNOWN => warning, NOT scored
facts.why: exec.arbitrary/flow.out(caller_arbitrary) on Boring vaults ($10-45M each) would be catastrophic IF the gate were a weak key. The scorer refuses to score them as bad without a witness. If any BoringVault.manage is actually EOA-gated, it flips to a large finding and the grade drops.
facts.onchain_check: Spot-check: read the BoringVault authority()/manager and confirm it is a ManagerWithMerkleVerification contract (not an EOA), and that manage() requires a merkle proof.

facts.scorer_used: EOA 0xd55df8...; exec.arbitrary with destination_constraint=not_determined (severity 1.0) but ~$0 DIRECT balance => floor band 0.15
facts.why: Arbitrary external call by an EOA is catastrophic-shaped; it scores at the floor only because the manager holds ~$0 directly. Its TRUE reach (EigenLayer-restaked ETH via EtherFiNodes) is not in contract_balances, so this is understated — a value-coverage gap worth confirming.
facts.onchain_check: eth_getCode(0xd55df8) == '0x'; and assess EtherFiNodes' EigenLayer restaked position (delegationManager shares) to size the true value-at-stake.
